key.name: min-isps
key.description: An IP counts as widely blocked when more than this many ISPs block it.

key.name: football-ip-threshold
key.description: Football is considered to be on when more than this many widely blocked IPs exist.

key.name: cf-key-ips
key.description: Football is considered to be on when every one of these IPs is blocked by at least one ISP. An empty list disables this rule.

key.name: include-ipv6
key.description: Whether IPv6 addresses are counted when evaluating the football state and the blocked IP count.

key.name: notifications
key.description: Whether to notify when football starts or ends.
